title: Leadership Has Nothing To Do With People
text: [Music] if you are depressed by the departure of people from your organization you are not a true leader because leadership has nothing to do with people if you want to be great he says you don't focus on people you focus on serving something to them greatness therefore is finding what you were born to serve the world i repeat greatness leadership is found when you discover what you were born to serve the world it has nothing to do with title nothing to do with dress nothing to do with accolades if you find what you were born to serve us we'll look for you i'm going to make a statement you'll understand it next year true leaders do not seek for followers followers seek true leaders and so he rebuked the philosophy that day he didn't rebuke the desire for greatness he showed them how to become great you
